hypothesis: Reduce noisy time variation in L120 three-seed predictions by centered plus/minus 30-minute averaging before unchanged endpoint projection
order: unprojected L120 mean3 -> station/layer complete 10-minute grid centered rolling 7 -> unchanged clip then endpoint-direction PAVA
missing_rows: Missing prediction times participate as NaN; return only original requested rows. No interpolation, no cross-station/layer/fold smoothing.
selection_provenance: Fable selected window7 after inspecting exposed OOF windows 1,7,13,...73; NOT selected before all data access. This config fixes an execution candidate before Codex evaluation/materialization, not a fresh confirmatory preregistration.
primary: B3 September-October natural RMSE; pooled/outage/layer risks also reported
comparator: L120 s3 projection only, same rows/same projection
decision: Verify Fable values and full scope, then prepare fixed window7 after independent numerical QA. Public score is never used to adjust window/weights. Worst-fold decline reported separately, not automatic veto.
